references.text: Jesus also warns in Matthew about false messiahs who will lead many astray.
Luke records a similar warning from Jesus about those who come in his name and lead people astray.
In the Revelation of John, the four horsemen are mentioned, where the first can be interpreted as a false Christ who deceives many.
In Isaiah, there is a warning against those who call evil good and good evil, which relates to the deception by false messiahs.
Jeremiah warns against false prophets who deceive the people, similar to the warning Jesus gives.
